events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Secure access for the diagnostic work
events.decision: Is access to pharmacy staff and process data confirmed for the requirements work?
agenda: Present the diagnostic approach and the first six weeks
Discuss the pharmacy staff and process data the work needs
Confirm access to those people and data

events.label: Check-in: requirements
events.decision: Do the interim requirements stand as the basis for the remaining process areas?
agenda: Present the interim requirements for the first process areas
Discuss open questions for the remaining process areas
Confirm whether the interim requirements stand

events.label: Requirements sign-off
events.purpose: Sign off requirements and gap findings
events.decision: Go or no-go on starting vendor selection against the signed-off requirements?
agenda: Present the business requirements by process area
Review the requirements and gap findings for sign-off
Decide on starting vendor selection

events.label: Check-in: vendor scoring
events.decision: Do the shortlist and scoring hold as the basis for the selection gate?
agenda: Present the vendor shortlist against signed-off requirements
Review the vendor scoring against the requirements
Confirm the shortlist and scoring as the basis for the gate

events.label: Vendor selection
events.decision: Which vendor's point-of-sale system is taken forward into implementation?
agenda: Present the business case for the vendor selection decision
Review the vendor shortlist and scoring against requirements
Decide which vendor goes into implementation

events.label: Check-in: first build
events.purpose: Check the first configured process areas
events.decision: Does the test record support continuing with the remaining process areas?
agenda: Present the first configured process areas
Review the test record and any open issues
Confirm the approach for the remaining process areas

events.label: Workshop 1: pilot readiness
events.decision: Go or no-go on starting the pilot pharmacy go-live?
agenda: Present the readiness report with data load rehearsal results
Review the first configured process areas and their test record
Decide on go or no-go for the pilot pharmacy go-live

events.label: Check-in: pilot results
events.purpose: Review pilot stability and wave plans
events.decision: Which pilot findings change how waves 3 and 4 are prepared?
agenda: Present the pilot go-live record and stability report
Discuss the pilot findings that bear on waves 3 and 4
Confirm the changes to apply to the coming waves

events.label: Workshop 2: waves 3 and 4
events.decision: Go or no-go on starting rollout waves 3 and 4 as planned?
agenda: Present the go-live record for waves 1 and 2
Review pilot and wave results against the plan for waves 3 and 4
Decide whether waves 3 and 4 start as planned

events.label: Final readout
events.decision: Approve the system as running in all 40 pharmacies and close the engagement?
agenda: Present the final readout and go-live record for all 40 pharmacies
Review results against the goal of running in all 40 pharmacies
Decide on approval and closing the engagement
